title: Sign this change with your passkey
why: Changes to your connections and your account are signed by you, so nobody else, not even someone running the server, can make them in your name.

record.summary: Show the exact record you are signing

purpose.friend_request: You are sending a friend request.
purpose.friend_accept: You are accepting a friend request.
purpose.invite_inviter: You are inviting someone you are with in person.
purpose.invite_invitee: You are joining with an in-person invite.
purpose.passkey_add: You are adding a passkey to your account.
purpose.passkey_remove: You are removing a passkey from your account.
purpose.recovery_approve: You are approving an account recovery.
purpose.mod_action: You are confirming a moderation action.
